question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Becoming**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in present tense, so the correct verb form would be present participle (-**ing **form).
 
• "**Becoming**" is the present participle of "become".
 
 
• Example: "*I am becoming more confident in my abilities.*"
 
 

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Became **is the past tense of 'become'.
 
• **Become **is the base form of the verb.
 
• **Becomes **is the third person singular present tense form.
